identification: Toledo 'Honest Weight / No Springs' 2 lb fan-dial counter scale (the small candy/confectionery or kitchen size, Toledo 405/4030 family), cast iron body in gold/bronze paint with red-filled raised lettering (TOLEDO on base, NO SPRINGS and HONEST WEIGHT on the fan), 0-2 lb chart in ounces, polished brass scoop pan, levelling foot screw. Australian-market example with a B. Goodhead Pty Ltd (scale importers, Melbourne and Sydney) dealer plate on the column, probably 1940s-50s. Armitage estimate A$40-60.
